SwiftUICore.framework.role: Foundational primitive framework defining ScrollGeometry, ScrollPhase, and View graph graph-node types

overridden_methods.behavior: Intercepts content offset mutations, checks _isProgrammaticUpdate to prevent feedback echoes, updates ScrollGeometry, and delegates to super
Internal callback triggered when SwiftUI binding changes; coordinates animation timing curves with CATransaction
Emits ScrollPhase.interacting transition to SwiftUICore and routes touch to UIKit pan gesture recognizer
Extracts content offset and bounds, constructs new ScrollGeometry struct, and publishes to AttributeGraph

_SwiftUIScrollViewBridge.role: Mediates between value-type SwiftUI AttributeGraph nodes and reference-type UIKitCore views

interactive_scroll: 1. User finger movement triggers UIScrollViewPanGestureRecognizer in UIKitCore
3. Bridge reads contentOffset, contentSize, contentInsets, and boundsSize
5. Bridge maps offset to bound ScrollPosition value via nearest anchor or raw point
6. Bridge issues AttributeGraph transaction to re-evaluate downstream SwiftUI views
programmatic_scroll: 1. Developer mutates $scrollPosition Binding or calls ScrollViewProxy.scrollTo(id, anchor:)
3. Bridge calculates target CGPoint from target view frame or anchor coordinate
5. Bridge calls -[_UIHostingScrollView setContentOffset:animated:] within animation transaction
6. Reciprocal _observeScrollViewDidScroll notifications check _isProgrammaticUpdate and suppress feedback
7. When deceleration/animation completes, Bridge resets _isProgrammaticUpdate = false

built_in_behaviors.name: viewAligned

scrollIndicators.underlying_implementation: Maps .hidden / .visible to showsHorizontalScrollIndicator and showsVerticalScrollIndicator ivars

gesture_arbitration.architecture: SwiftUI installs high-priority gesture recognizers on _UIHostingScrollView
gesture_arbitration.arbitration_rule: SwiftUI gestures take precedence over child responder gestures unless simultaneousGesture is declared; UIKit pan gesture recognizer retains primary touch routing and delegates simultaneous evaluation via gestureRecognizer:shouldRecognizeSimultaneouslyWithGestureRecognizer:
